title: DP-CGANS (Differentially Private - Conditional Generative Adversarial NetworkS)
summary: A differentially private conditional GAN for generating synthetic tabular (and RDF/ontology-derived) data, here extended with ontology embeddings for personal health data generation. It vendors and modifies SDV's CTGAN synthesizer, data transformer/sampler, constraints, and metadata modules in-tree, altering the conditional matrix and cost functions to better model imbalanced correlated data, so SDV's CTGAN, RDT, and metadata code are directly copied and modified rather than merely imported.
affiliations: Institute of Data Science, Maastricht University
evidence: src/dp_cgans/__init__.py:9-13: 'This package is extended from ctgan and SDV... main changes are in ctgan/synthesizers/ctgan.py ../data_sampler.py ../data_transformer.py'
needs: This is an ontology-extended fork of the sunchang0124/dp_cgans project (which itself is a heavily modified, vendored derivative of SDV/CTGAN); README content and byline appear inherited from upstream rather than written for this specific fork, so authorship attribution to this exact repo is uncertain.
